intent.raw: Define, design, and plan the accepted learning graph as a regenerable learner projection that helps a user ask the next evidence-bound question without creating ontology or route authority.
intent.objective: Produce a validated Define, Design, and Plan package for a deterministic learner projection and defer all mutation until learner-view mutation admission and one explicit SWU selection.
intent.operator_sentence: Invoke authors a candidate projection contract, validates the Design denominator and fixed point, plans serial atomic SWUs, validates recomposition with Distill, and stops before learner-view mutation admission or Task Session execution.

steps.name: Build bounded authoring context from accepted research
stop_conditions: Accepted research or frozen source digests do not match current bytes.
The target cannot be bounded without a new ontology, product, or executable route.

steps.name: Define the learner projection boundary
stop_conditions: The projection would own semantic identity, comprehension, learner-view mutation admission, semantic admission, destination-owner admission, or execution.
Killed vocabulary or a second generic learning-map product is required.

steps.name: Author the six-view design and selected UX/witness companions
stop_conditions: Any required baseline view or selected extension is absent.
A planned witness is represented as executed Plan or human evidence.

steps.name: Validate closed denominator and two-pass Design selection
stop_conditions: The manifest is stale, open, self-issued, or has unknowns.
Any denominator signal is unbound or pass-one/pass-two digests differ.

steps.name: Layer and split the serial implementation Work Pack
stop_conditions: An SWU bundles independently verifiable structure, presentation, state, or interaction behaviors.
Any mutation SWU lacks exact write scope, baseline, validation, owner receipt, or deterministic successor policy.
A SWU is selected or any admission is inferred.

steps.name: Validate atomicity, narrowness, and recomposition
stop_conditions: The first candidate is task-shaped or not the narrowest reversible trust step.
Any SWU cannot recompose into the learner loop and selected Design concerns.

steps.name: Defer one-SWU Task Session handoff until mutation admission and selection
stop_conditions: Learner-view mutation admission is absent or stale.
No eligible SWU is explicitly selected by the user.
The requested route would execute a suggestion, alter authority, or exceed one SWU.

gates.condition: Define artifacts preserve the accepted projection boundary and exact source contracts.
The closed denominator passes and both selection passes have the same digest with all required outputs selected.
Layering, split tasks, ten atomic SWUs, disjoint receipt producers, validation, and navigation are complete.
Narrowness, atomicity, deferred complexity, and recomposition pass with zero task-shaped SWUs.
The learner-view owner admits exact mutation scope, ceiling, validation, current baseline, and supersession policy; the receipt cannot act as semantic evidence or destination-owner admission.
Exactly one eligible SWU is explicitly selected after learner-view mutation admission; current selected_swu remains none.
Planning, fixture, browser, human, adapter, semantic, workflow, and promotion evidence remain separate; no suggestion executes.

subagent_strategy.explanation: The authoring route is serial and locally validated. A two-role Distill dispatch was not separately presented and confirmed, so Distill used the contract-compatible local Proposer/Balancer simulation. Later Task Session executes one SWU at a time.

observability.signal_grouping: Group the Invoke parent and Distill child under this dispatch id; neither telemetry nor the background package audit changes mutation authority.

boundaries.contract: Invoke consumes accepted research by exact path and digest without promoting candidate records.
Normal Plan consumes only the current fixed-point Design receipt; planned witnesses remain unexecuted.
Invoke authors candidate plans only; learner-view mutation admission is separate and mandatory before mutation and cannot supply semantic or destination-owner admission.
One selected Task Session may write only its exact product inventory after baseline and admission checks.
Task Session and lifecycle-owner receipts have disjoint producers and write scopes; Invoke Refresh consumes both and may make one successor eligible, never selected.
The projection only displays a candidate owner-route string and verification package; no workflow state or action crosses the boundary.

authority.memory: not in scope; no real learner-state persistence
authority.promotion: CyberAlchemy-v2 and downstream lifecycle owners; never granted by this dispatch

state_namespaces.write_policy: Invoke authors only this planning package; later refresh writes exact closeout targets.
One selected SWU writes exact admitted product paths; canonical ontology/profile sources are excluded.
Disposable authority-none generated snapshot and receipt; no canonical promotion.
Write exact baseline, validation, and task-session evidence only; no owner receipts.
Write only the separately validated lifecycle-owner receipt for the selected SWU; browser evidence is audit_reference input only.

promotion_splits.source: fixture, DOM, browser, human, or adapter evidence
promotion_splits.target: ontology, workflow admission, product promotion, publication, release, or deployment
promotion_splits.rule: Each target requires its own current owner decision; no evidence family promotes another automatically.

promotion_guardrails: Plan completeness is not learner-view mutation admission, semantic admission, destination-owner admission, SWU selection, or implementation authorization.
Generated projection behavior is not canonical ontology authority.
Fixture and browser evidence are not semantic identity, comprehension, or accessibility acceptance.
A displayed candidate owner-route string is not confirmation, registration, dispatch, or execution.
No artifact here proves promotion, publication, release, deployment, or production readiness.
